name: Laser source
text: Mounts on a floor, wall or ceiling. When powered it grows a solid laser bridge up to 14 m long, shorter with weaker redstone power; dye it to colour the beam. Lasers cut through air and grass but stop at solid blocks. Age VII.

name: Laser fence source
text: Same source as the bridge laser, but the beam is a thin fence you can see through and walk into. Craft it from a laser source and back again. Age VII.
